etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Middle English iperbole, yperbole, from Latin hyperbolē, from Ancient Greek ὑπερβολή (huperbolḗ, “excess, exaggeration”), from ὑπέρ (hupér, “above”) + βάλλω (bállō, “to throw”, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *gʷelH-). Doublet of hyperbola.
senses: (uncountable, rhetoric, literature) Deliberate overstatement, particularly extreme overstatement.
(countable) An instance or example of such overstatement.
